title: Impact of smear layer removal protocols on color dynamics and dentin hardness following intracoronal bleaching
core_idea: Evaluate whether different smear layer removal treatments (distilled water, 17% EDTA, 37% phosphoric acid, and no treatment) applied to artificially stained human premolars prior to intracoronal bleaching with sodium perborate influence post-bleaching tooth color (CIELab/CIEDE2000 measured by Vita Easyshade) and dentin microhardness (Vickers) over 7, 14, and 21 days.
tldr: Study objective and design: compare smear layer removal protocols versus control on color change and dentin hardness after intracoronal bleaching of stained human premolars, with measurements at 7, 14, and 21 days and appropriate statistical testing (Shapiro–Wilk, Levene’s, two-way repeated ANOVA with Tukey’s HSD).
